title: Crunchy Scallion Pancake
description: A crispy, savory pancake originating from Chinese cuisine, typically served as a side dish or appetizer.

ingredients.name: all-purpose flour
ingredients.notes: Make sure to use gluten-free flour if necessary

instructions: In a large mixing bowl, combine flour and salt.
Gradually pour in water while stirring the flour with a fork until a dough forms.
Add chopped scallions and mix until well combined.
Knead the dough for about 10 minutes until smooth.
Divide the dough into 4-6 equal pieces, depending on the desired pancake size.
Roll out each piece into a thin circle, about 1/8 inch thick.
Heat a non-stick skillet or wok over medium-high heat.
Brush the surface with sesame oil and cook the pancake for 1-2 minutes on each side, until crispy and golden brown.
Brush with vegetable oil and serve hot.
For extra crispy pancakes, you can deep-fry them at 350°F (175°C) for 2-3 minutes on each side.
